title: agent-message
description: One message between agents. The payload holds an intent_id and a body_ref only; the words live in the private file body_ref names.

subject.description: msg. then 1 to 15 dotted ids: NATS-safe, and no word fits as written.

payload.description: A closed list of keys: a new one is a schema change and a schema_version bump.

ref.description: An opaque file name in the private refs folder: 16 to 64 lowercase hex, then .md, .json or .txt. No word fits as written; an encoded one does.

utc.description: ISO-8601 in UTC, Z only, optional fraction.
